description: This PHP script handles user password reset or generation within the SuiteCRM system, including email verification, password link generation, and email notification functions.

classes.name: user
classes.description: A class representing a user, with methods for retrieving user data, email verification, and sending password emails.

methods.name: retrieve_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves a user ID given a username.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads user data based on user ID.

methods.name: isPrimaryEmail
methods.description: Checks if a provided email is the primary email for the user.

methods.name: sendEmailForPassword
methods.description: Sends an email to facilitate password reset or setup based on given template ID and data.
